name: pi-launcher-tauri
description: Windows Pi Web desktop launcher using Tauri v2 and WebView2

scripts.build: npm run check:version && tauri build --ci --no-sign --bundles nsis -- --locked
scripts.test:tools: node --test scripts/test-release-unit.js scripts/test-backend-tools.js scripts/test-version-unit.js scripts/test-stage-unit.js scripts/test-tray-unit.js
